"""Tests for the --tag filter option on the notes list command."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from click.testing import CliRunner

# Ensure src/ is on sys.path (same trick as test_cli.py)
from tests import _ensure_src_on_path  # noqa: F401 – side‑effect

from notes.cli import cli
from notes.storage import STORAGE_PATH


def _clean_storage() -> None:
    if STORAGE_PATH.exists():
        STORAGE_PATH.unlink()


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def clean_out() -> None:
    """Start every test with a fresh storage file."""
    _clean_storage()


class TestListTagFilter:
    """--tag TAGNAME filters the list output to notes containing that tag."""

    def setup_method(self) -> None:
        runner = CliRunner()
        # Note A has tags: python, cli
        runner.invoke(
            cli,
            ["add", "--title", "A", "--body", "a", "--tags", "python,cli"],
            catch_exceptions=False,
        )
        # Note B has tag: web
        runner.invoke(
            cli,
            ["add", "--title", "B", "--body", "b", "--tags", "web"],
            catch_exceptions=False,
        )
        # Note C has no tags
        runner.invoke(
            cli,
            ["add", "--title", "C", "--body", "c"],
            catch_exceptions=False,
        )

    def test_tag_filter_shows_matching_note(self) -> None:
        result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, ["list", "--tag", "python"])
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "A" in result.output
        assert "B" not in result.output
        assert "C" not in result.output

    def test_tag_filter_excludes_non_matching(self) -> None:
        result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, ["list", "--tag", "web"])
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "B" in result.output
        assert "A" not in result.output
        assert "C" not in result.output

    def test_tag_filter_no_match(self) -> None:
        result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, ["list", "--tag", "nonexistent"])
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "No notes found." in result.output

    def test_tag_filter_case_insensitive(self) -> None:
        result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, ["list", "--tag", "PYTHON"])
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "A" in result.output

    def test_tag_combined_with_tags_option(self) -> None:
        # --tags python and --tag cli → note A has both
        result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, ["list", "--tags", "python", "--tag", "cli"])
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "A" in result.output
        assert "B" not in result.output
        assert "C" not in result.output

    def test_tag_combined_with_tags_or_semantics(self) -> None:
        # --tags python and --tag web → OR semantics: note A (python) or B (web) match
        result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, ["list", "--tags", "python", "--tag", "web"])
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "A" in result.output
        assert "B" in result.output
        assert "C" not in result.output

    def test_tag_without_tags_option(self) -> None:
        # Only --tag, no --tags
        result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, ["list", "--tag", "cli"])
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "A" in result.output
        assert "B" not in result.output

    def test_no_tag_option_lists_all(self) -> None:
        # No --tag and no --tags → list everything
        result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, ["list"])
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "A" in result.output
        assert "B" in result.output
        assert "C" in result.output

    def test_tag_on_empty_store(self) -> None:
        _clean_storage()
        result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, ["list", "--tag", "anything"])
        assert result.exit_code == 0
        assert "No notes found." in result.output
